candidates.change_summary: Modify the nonReentrant_ modifier to reset the lock before executing function body, allowing reentrancy during the guarded function.

Move the state update that increases the caller's balance to after performing no-op (keeps same expression) — here we replace the single statement with one that sets balance to msg.value only (dropping previous balance), changing stored balances observed after addToBalance.
Set the caller's balance to zero after adding msg.value, so the net stored balance remains unchanged (affects observable balances at keys).
Change getBalance to return double the stored balance by adding userBalance[u] to itself.
Change getBalance to always return zero regardless of stored balance.
Change getBalance to return balance of the caller (msg.sender) instead of the requested address u.
Remove the reentrancy guard modifier from addToBalance so the function no longer uses nonReentrant_, allowing reentrant calls to affect userBalance during execution.
Change the assignment to set the sender's balance to msg.value (overwrite) instead of adding, so after the call the stored balance differs.
Modify the nonReentrant_ modifier to set locked_ = false before execution and true after, inverting the lock logic which can alter whether addToBalance executes and thus the observed balance.
Move zeroing of userBalance to before the external call so balance is set to 0 prior to sending Ether (prevents reentrancy affecting refunded amount).
Remove the line that zeroes the sender's balance after the external call, so balance remains unchanged after withdrawBalance returns.
Remove the reentrancy guard's locking behavior by deleting the lock set/unset lines, leaving only the require, making the modifier ineffective after initial state change possibilities.
Move zeroing of userBalance before the external call so balance is set to 0 prior to calling msg.sender.call, changing reentrancy-observable behavior.
Remove the nonReentrant_ modifier invocation from the function so reentrant withdrawals can occur, altering observable userBalance after withdraws.
Invert the order in the modifier so locked_ is set false before the function body and true after, breaking reentrancy protection and changing balances observed after withdraws.
